item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J03265","case1_error":"Reports 200 pairs instead of the requested 400 individual plugs.","case2_error":"Writes Tim's age as twice John's plus five, and adds historical ages instead of preserving the twelve-year age difference.","reason":"Case 1 answers in the wrong unit; case 2 constructs incorrect age relations.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03266","case1_error":"Provides unsupported final numbers after correct formulas; the formulas yield 3240 minutes.","case2_error":"Provides unsupported final answer 48 after correct formulas that yield 60 chairs.","reason":"Both give incorrect final numbers without showing the numerical calculations, despite correctly specifying the required formulas.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J03267","case1_error":"Doubles the second country's stay to obtain the third, rather than doubling the first country's stay for both.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final answer 80 after correct formulas that yield four weeks.","reason":"Case 1 uses an incorrect comparison base; case 2 supplies an unsupported number after correct formulas.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03268","case1_error":"Omits the ten additional Saturday rounds, undercounting the weekend by 300 minutes.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final answer 340 after correct deduction formulas that yield 184 dollars.","reason":"Case 1 omits a stated contribution; case 2 gives an unsupported numerical result despite including every deduction correctly.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03269","case1_error":"Invents an initial zero-cookie count and uses inconsistent inventory updates, ignoring the two returned cookies.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written expression 34 minus 8 minus 9 as 27 instead of 17.","reason":"Case 1 invents an initial condition and mishandles inventory relations; case 2 explicitly miscalculates a correct expression.","judgment":"different"}]}
